label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is generated using java.lang.Math.random(), which is insecure randomness. The value is used to create a rememberMeKey, which could be used for session management or authentication purposes. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is derived from user-provided parameters (via cookies) and directly concatenated into the response output without proper sanitization. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.
